setup.title: Swarm AI safety · one-day research hackathon

citizenship.objective: Collaborate on a source-grounded, falsifiable swarm AI safety project feasible in eight hours.
citizenship.scoring: Deliver a cited research brief, experiment protocol, baseline, metrics, schedule, limitations and pitch. Findings remain hypotheses until tested.

pricing.assumptions: Planning allowance: four web-action turns per agent plus collaboration rounds and one final synthesis. Assumes 6,000 additional context tokens per round, accumulated thread history, 1,200 output tokens per turn and a larger final brief. Search-provider fees are excluded. Synthesis failover can add up to four extra model turns beyond this quote. Actual usage varies; this is not a cap. Demo performs no web or model calls.

rules: Research → proposals → critique → final synthesis; each contribution is shared before the next agent responds.
Each agent can request up to four search/page-read actions per run. Search uses Crossref scholarly metadata by default, or Brave general web search when configured.
All agents share retrieved sources and discuss evidence. Web failures are explicit; citations must refer to retrieved sources.
Agent turns have a 600-second deadline. Timed-out turns are skipped; synthesis falls back to another agent.
The final brief plans one eight-hour day. This task does not execute the proposed empirical experiment.
